title: Zebra with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='30' ry='20' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- stripes on body -->
  <path d='M28 52 Q32 62 28 72' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 47 Q42 62 38 77' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 45 Q54 62 50 79' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 47 Q66 62 62 77' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 52 Q76 62 72 72' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='76' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e6e6e6'/>
  <rect x='44' y='78' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <rect x='58' y='78' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#e6e6e6'/>
  <rect x='68' y='76' width='8' height='16' rx='3' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='30' y='89' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='91' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <rect x='68' y='89' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M22 52 Q18 36 24 26 L32 30 Q26 42 30 54 Z' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <path d='M24 40 Q22 46 26 50' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='24' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#f2f2f2'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='29' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#d8d8e0'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='27' r='1.5' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='32' r='1.5' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='13' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#f2f2f2' transform='rotate(-15 28 13)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='13' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#d0a0b0' transform='rotate(-15 30 13)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='14' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#f2f2f2' transform='rotate(15 40 14)'/>
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='14' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#d0a0b0' transform='rotate(15 40 14)'/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d='M30 12 Q36 8 42 13 Q38 16 34 15 Q40 18 44 15' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 16 Q22 14 20 20' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripe on head -->
  <path d='M34 16 Q36 22 34 28' stroke='#2a2a3a' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sparkly eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='21' r='5' fill='#18182a'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='21' r='5' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='34.5' cy='19' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='23' r='1' fill='#a8e8ff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='19' r='0.8' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <path d='M44 16 L45 19 L48 20 L45 21 L44 24 L43 21 L40 20 L43 19 Z' fill='#fff6b0'/>
  <path d='M26 12 L26.8 14 L29 14.8 L26.8 15.6 L26 18 L25.2 15.6 L23 14.8 L25.2 14 Z' fill='#a8e8ff'/>
  <path d='M47 25 L47.6 26.5 L49 27 L47.6 27.5 L47 29 L46.4 27.5 L45 27 L46.4 26.5 Z' fill='#ffb0e8'/>
</svg>
